headline: Bitcoin Falls Below $80,000 as Traders De-Risk Before Fed Meeting
summary: Bitcoin fell below $80,000 alongside losses in Ether and XRP as cryptocurrency traders de-risked ahead of the Federal Reserve meeting. Goldman Sachs cut its Kospi target by 25%.
why: Bitcoin and major cryptocurrencies are highly sensitive to Federal Reserve monetary policy and broader shifts in global financial liquidity.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Investors reduced exposure to risk assets in anticipation of monetary policy guidance from the Federal Reserve.

why_moved: Cryptocurrency prices declined as market participants de-risked portfolios prior to the US Federal Reserve policy announcement.
